visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and silver earrings, wearing a dark grey hoodie, sits in a dimly lit indoor room. She holds a large cardboard shipping box and looks at the camera with a secretive, playful expression. Yellow and white text overlays are visible at the bottom of the frame. She uses a white utility cutter to carefully slice the tape on the box. (2) The woman pulls a yellow and black Logitech keyboard box out of the shipping container. She holds it up to the camera, gesturing with her fingers as if explaining a secret. The lighting is warm and focused on her face, while the background remains dark. (3) She presents a grey mechanical keyboard with orange accent keys. She brings the keyboard very close to her face, resting her chin near it while looking into the lens. A yellow text box with brackets appears. She then holds the keyboard in her lap and gestures towards it while talking. (4) The scene shifts to a living room where a large film is being projected onto a wall. The woman is sitting in a brown leather chair, typing on the new grey keyboard. Another woman in a white t-shirt stands behind her, looking at the screen. The environment is lit by a red-toned lamp and the projector light. (5) The second woman leans down to inspect the desk area. The main character quickly swaps or hides the keyboard, holding up a different white keyboard to distract her. Both women eventually break into laughter, with the main character clutching her chest and looking up at the ceiling. The video ends with a circular zoomed-in shot of her laughing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice whispering in an ASMR-style, secretive tone. The sharp, rhythmic sound of a utility knife slicing through tape is heard clearly. A soft, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody plays in the background at a low volume. (2) As the speaker begins a normal conversational flow, the acoustic guitar continues with a gentle, major-key pluck. There are frequent 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects synchronized with the appearance of on-screen text overlays. (3) The music fades slightly to highlight a hyper-dense sequence of percussive keyboard clicking sounds. The clicks have a high spectral brightness, emphasizing the tactile quality of the hardware. The speaker's voice remains warm and friendly. (4) A more energetic, comedic BGM track starts. A low-frequency synthetic thud, resembling a heartbeat, occurs during a moment of suspense. Two female voices are heard interacting; one is questioning and the other is mock-defensive. (5) The audio track concludes with high-arousal, loud female laughter from both individuals. The music swells in volume with a bright, upbeat piano and drum beat. A final comedic slide-whistle or 'pop' sound effect ends the sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Narrative Analogy -> Product Demonstration -> Humorous Skit -> CTA/Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a Logitech mechanical keyboard through a humorous, lifestyle-oriented lens. The video uses the 'hiding shopping parcels from my wife' trope to create a relatable comedic situation while highlighting the product's aesthetic and sound profile (ASMR).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear showcase of Logitech product packaging, keyboard features, and ASMR sound testing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines consumer tech review elements (ASMR, unboxing) with short-form comedy tropes. The use of high-density text overlays and sound effects is typical of social media viral trends.
